notes.title: 50 K Thanks!
notes.content:
Hello. Erzurum has sold over 50.000 copies in 7 months. As a celebration, I would like to share interesting facts of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38500200/82292723a92d6745f369af8255c230e990435f0b.png[/img]

[b]Top Seller on the launch day[/b]

Erzurum stayed the top seller Steam game for 8 hours on its launch day, 02.10.2021. It remained at top 10 the following couple of days. It sold 3448 copies on the launch day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38500200/e7f441d798ddc1c20d59573bd890c0d99824c388.png[/img]

[b]Impressions and Visits[/b]

Erzurum has visibility over 26 million on any page of Steam and Erzurum store page has been visited 2.6 million times in 7 months. Daily visits have never decreased under 1000 in any day. Peak daily visit amount is 148.514 on 02.11.2021.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38500200/1e3190e40e20343c36274b7af2dd4b679c0f3f1f.png[/img]

[b]Wishlists[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38500200/e65ad00243c2d70907ef0a6152f5a066d84c6083.png[/img]

[b]Daily active users and concurrent users[/b]

notes.title: Development of Erzurum is Over
notes.content:
Hello. I'm sad to announce that the development of Erzurum is over. Here is the technical explanation of why I can't continue to develop the game :

On May 2021, I upgraded Unreal Engine from 4.25.3 to 4.25.6 while I was designing the second episode.  After upgrading, I got an error that the project can't be opened because of the different version. Since then, I've been searching the net for possible solutions but couldn't success. Apparently, the only version of Unreal Engine that Erzurum works is 4.25.3 and it can't be accessed anymore because when you try to install 4.25.xx version of the engine, it offers you the latest version, which is 4.25.6.

That's why, I've decided not to wait anymore for a solution. This is my fault. I've learnt that I shouldn't upgrade the game engine while in a development in a hard way. I'm really sorry for the mistake.

As a summary, Erzurum won't update anymore, 1.06 is the final version of the game. Thank you for your understanding and your great support. Hope to see you in the future projects.

notes.content: Hello. Steam achievements has been added. Existing players' completed achievements can be obtained by loading their games. Enjoy :)

notes.title: Erzurum Update 1.03
notes.content:
Hello. This is a small update. It consists of some fixes and improvements. Normally I would post this with the Steam achievements but there is a possibility that the achievements won't work so I'm publishing it as a separate patch. To see if the achievements work, I will try 3-4 achievements first. If they succeed, I will add the rest.

* Fixed the blizzard count down appearing when loading an existing game.
* Added the notification window popping when pressing the new game button in story mode, if a saved file exists.
* Cancelled saving cooking food due to some complications after loading.
* Increased stamina regeneration rate.
* Escape key now both opens and closes the pause menu.
* Fixed some interfaces overlapping.

notes.title: Update Calendar
notes.content:
Hello. It's been a month since the game was released. Although the game was released in full version, there's still a lot work to do. I would like to share the work to be done on the game in the next few months.

[b]March[/b]

* Steam achievements.
* New food : chestnut, corn, potato, cag kebab.
* New crafting item : sewing kit.
* The second cooking slot on the stove.
* More graphics and gameplay options.

[b]June[/b]

* Remastered version of episode 1: includes new objectives and renewed versions of some of the current objectives.
* Episode 2 : The Search, will take place in the famous ski resort Palandöken.
* Full voice-over (episode 1 & episode 2).
* New soundtracks.

The next update calendar will be announced when the second episode is released. Thank you for supporting me so I can keep improving the game.

Fatih Uzun, everything of Proximity Games :)

notes.title: Erzurum Update 1.02
notes.content:
Hello. Second update of Erzurum :

* Added Russian language.
* Rifle aiming animations have been slowed down.
* Pistol aiming animations have been slowed down.
* Fixed autosave file not being deleted when starting a new game.
* Fixed occurring rare wardrobe interaction issue when interacting with objects other than wardrobe.
* Fixed getting stuck next to a tree.
* Improved bears' path finding abilities.
* Disabled motion blur everywhere (cameras, post process, etc).
* Fixed the character not playing dying animation while aiming, crouching, aiming while crouched.
* Radial menu buttons are now gray and disabled if the character doesn't have the corresponding item.

notes.title: Erzurum Update 1.01
notes.content:
Hello everyone. The first update of Erzurum :

* Added Chinese language.
* Added auto save feature for the Story mode.
* Audio volume levels are now being saved.
* Instant loading in the same map has been cancelled, due to some errors on the inventory and missions.
* Disabled aiming of weapons while the weapon drawing animation is playing. This prevents playing wrong walking animation while a weapon is equipped.
* Fixed bandages still stay in the inventory after using it.
* Fixed : The item condition drops to zero when transferring the item from a storage to the inventory by right click.
* Replaced bears with boars on the final story mission.
* Fixed the repetition of Taylan's reaction when he sees the imam, in the story mode.
* Animals' hearing range of gunshots has increased by 10 meters.
* Boars now attack when they are hit, instead of fleeing.
* Aggressive animals now stop stalking the player if the player is out of sight.
